summary: Sedona, Arizona, independent consultant, software developer, author of multiple technical books, expertise in Ruby, Common Lisp, Java, and web technologies, strong preference for cloud services (AWS, Google AppEngine), advocates for locally grown organic food, enjoys hiking and cooking, has a pet Myers Parrot, married, values a modest lifestyle, critical of credit-based living, interested in semantic web technologies, follows a mix of liberal and conservative political views, emphasizes the importance of personal data privacy, engaged in ongoing learning and experimentation with new programming languages and technologies.
